notes.title: Software function optimization
notes.notes:
[b]update content[/b]
1. Fix the problem of afterimage when uploading a png background with a blank area
2. The avatar removes the window area and it will automatically reset
3. The lock function and hide ui function have been added to the configuration, and the restart will still take effect

Suggestions about obs transparent streaming:
1. Select a solid color background in the PngTuber Maker software
2. Select "Window Capture" in the OBS software to capture the PngTuber Maker application window
3. Select "Window Capture" in OBS, right-click and select "Filter". Click on the plus button in the lower left corner and select "Chroma Key"
4. In the settings of the chroma key, there is basically no need to modify it. Just make sure that the color of the "key color type" is consistent with the background color in the PngTuber Maker app

If you run into any issues find us on discord
https://discord.gg/RW2ZbdZd

notes.title: Performance Optimization & New Feature
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473809/be2ef19d47320473219e591ae1f4eeaac52cfc3a.png[/img][b]Update Content[/b]

[h1]Performance Optimization[/h1]
1. Optimize the software crash problem
2. Optimize switching avatar memory increase problem
3. Fix audio input source freeze problem

[h1]UE Optimization[/h1]
1. When the avatar turns on the animation floating, the accessories will follow it synchronously
2. Optimize avatar feature user experience
3. Added accessories tab page category

[h1]New Feature[/h1]
1. Mouse listening feature

When you use the mouse monitoring function, if you press the mouse, the accessories you added will move with the mouse direction.

See tutorial in this video
